correctness.rationale: For each ordinary binary addition, the number of outgoing carries equals \(s_2(n)+s_2(t)-s_2(n+t)\), by summing the column equations. With precisely three shift one-bits, admissibility is equivalent to at most three carries. A carry surviving three zero columns after the immediately preceding one-bit forces at least four counted carries, so all zero gaps saturate at three, including the tail. Removing trailing zero shift bits is justified by \(c_{2t}=c_t\). The remaining sixteen canonical cases have lengths \(6+G+H\). An exact integer recurrence, including all initial/boundary states, yields the fully listed \(4\times4\) count table; independently enumerating every residue class gives the same integers. All possible gap parameters reduce to the table, proving the infinite quantified result. The packaged checker was executed successfully on its actual file and returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Fixed binary Hamming weight is a canonical structural restriction for Cusick densities and the theme of contemporary sharp-extremal research. Three one-bits is the first pattern class in which two independent internal gaps interact; the proof gives a complete sharp density invariant over an infinite doubly parametrized family. It identifies precisely five attainable rational levels and all global minimizers/maximizers, and explains an exact gap-length-three stabilization. These strengthen, rather than rename, known individual calculations and universal positivity. The exact small-weight phase diagram can serve as a benchmark for general fixed-weight extremal or carry-distribution questions; no downstream theorem is asserted.
